Subtract 316 days from 1615-04-14.  
1615 is not a leap year (divisible by 100 but not by 400).  
Days in 1615 before April 14: Jan 31 + Feb 28 + Mar 31 + 13 days in April = 103 days.  
316 − 103 = 213 days back into 1614. 1614 is not a leap year, so 213 days before 1615-01-01 is 1614-05-31? Let's check:  
From 1614-06-01 to end of 1614 is 214 days (June 30, July 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31, Nov 30, Dec 31 = 214).  
So 214 days before 1615-01-01 is 1614-06-01. 213 days before 1615-01-01 is 1614-06-02.  
Thus 316 days before 1615-04-14 = 1614-06-02.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1614-06-02
